header.name: Foundations of Biology II
header.description: The objective of this course is to explore the frontiers of modern biology! This course covers cellular signaling, molecular genetics, epigenetics, and cutting-edge biotechnology like CRISPR. Delve into evolution, immunology, neurobiology, and endocrinology, culminating in a look at emerging fields like genomics and synthetic biology.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Explain core principles of cellular communication, metabolism, and molecular genetics, including DNA repair and gene regulation.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Analyze and compare modern biotechnological techniques, such as CRISPR-Cas9, and their applications in genetic engineering.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Describe fundamental concepts in evolutionary biology, including phylogenetics, population genetics, and developmental processes.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Understand the mechanisms of immunological responses, neural signaling, and hormonal regulation within biological systems.

lecture_topics: Cellular Signaling, Metabolism & Communication: Signal Transduction Pathways, Hormonal Regulation & Second Messengers, Cell Metabolism
Molecular Genetics: DNA Integrity: DNA Damage and Repair Mechanisms, Homologous Recombination and Genetic Recombination
Epigenetics & Gene Regulation: DNA Methylation and Histone Modification, Epigenetic Inheritance and Phenotypic Variation
Biotechnology & Genetic Engineering: Recombinant DNA Technology, CRISPR-Cas9 and Genome Editing Principles
Phylogenetics & Systematics: Molecular Phylogenetics, Principles of Cladistics and Taxonomy
Population Genetics & Evolutionary Ecology: Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium, Introduction to Evolutionary Game Theory
Evolutionary Developmental Biology (Evo-Devo): Evolutionary Basis of Developmental Processes, Genetic Regulation of Morphological Evolution
Immunology & Host-Pathogen Interactions: Innate and Adaptive Immunity, Immunological Memory and Vaccines
Neurobiology & Behavior: Neural Signaling and Synaptic Transmission, Neural Basis of Behavior and Cognitive Processes
Endocrinology & Hormonal Regulation: Endocrine Glands and Hormone Function, Detailed Hormonal Regulation of Physiological Processes
Frontiers in Biology - Genomics & Big Data: Genomics and its impact, The role of Big Data in Biological Research
Frontiers in Biology - Synthetic Biology & Bioinformatics: Principles and applications of Synthetic Biology, Introduction to Bioinformatics tools
Frontiers in Biology - Biomedical Innovations & Course Wrap-up: Emerging Biomedical Innovations, Future Directions, Course Review
